data.narrative:
Glyphic Biotechnologies is a Series A biotech company founded by Joshua Yang and Daniel Estandian that has raised $44M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private companies in the Biotech & Health sector, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using total raised ($44M) as a proxy for Series A post-money value and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage transitions yields an implied valuation of $88M. Peer-median triangulation is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within narrow valuation tiers—while 7 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 meet the filtering criteria necessary for robust median calculation. Public-comp anchoring cannot be deployed without disclosed revenue figures, which are rarely available for private companies.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $75M to $101M, with $88M as the central estimate. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue data to validate public multiples and the limited peer set in this specific stage and valuation band. The single-method foundation warrants investor verification against deal precedent and internal return requirements before commitment.
